propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(repo, 'list') pattern to establish fixture preconditions via unasserted side effects, causing silent failures under CI load when the best-effort read path fails to land the sync.
8 of these 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions where a clone is strictly behind its peer and must fetch+merge to establish the intended state deterministically.
15 of these 23 sites use the read-side sync as the behavior under test itself, where the subsequent assertion characterizes reconvergence through the production read path.
Converting the 8 precondition sites from _engine_run(..., 'list') to checked _sync_from_origin (fetch + ff-only merge) eliminates silent setup failures while preserving deterministic test semantics.
The 15 read-sync sites require a named _reconverge_by_read_sync helper to document why the best-effort path is deliberately retained and to encapsulate the expire+list idiom.
